name: Center at Baybrook
summary: Center at Baybrook is a well-positioned community shopping center on Gulf Freeway in Webster, Texas, serving the Clear Lake area near NASA Johnson Space Center. Managed by Kimco Realty, it offers a convenient mix of retailers, dining, and services for the surrounding residential and professional communities.
demographics: Center at Baybrook serves the Webster and Clear Lake area of southeast Houston, attracting a diverse mix of middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals working in the nearby NASA Johnson Space Center and medical facilities. The trade area includes a strong representation of households with children, dual-income families, and retirees, with median household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $90,000. Shoppers in this area tend to prioritize convenience and value, seeking everyday necessities along with dining and service options close to home and work.
description: Center at Baybrook is a prominent community shopping destination located along the Gulf Freeway in Webster, Texas, strategically positioned in the heart of the Clear Lake area near NASA's Johnson Space Center. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, this property serves as a convenient retail hub for the surrounding residential communities and the thousands of professionals working in the nearby aerospace, medical, and energy sectors. The center offers a diverse mix of national retailers, local businesses, dining options, and essential services that cater to the daily needs of area residents. With its accessible location just off Interstate 45 and proximity to the larger Baybrook Mall, Center at Baybrook benefits from strong traffic patterns and serves as a complementary shopping option for the densely populated southeast Houston market. The property maintains consistent operating hours from 10 AM to 9 PM daily, providing flexibility for shoppers to visit before work, during lunch breaks, or in the evening hours.
